title: The CRM remembers the deal. IMOS remembers the person.

scenes.vo: Your CRM remembers the deal. Then it forgets the person.
Seventy-four percent of customers who go back to their salesperson buy again. Most never hear from them after delivery.
I'm On Social gives every rep a book of business that runs itself. Every morning: three people to talk to, and exactly why.
Reps just talk. It remembers the family, the trip, the birthday, and turns every one into a follow-up.
When a shopper opens a lot photo, the rep knows in seconds. The text is already written.
And when a rep moves on, the relationships stay with your store.
I'm On Social. The Relationship OS for dealerships. Book a demo at I'm On Social dot com.
